methodology.abstention_requirement: Strict neutral abstention ('Not enough evidence') on ungrounded or role-restricted inquiries. Zero existence leakage of confidential documents or tokens.

questions.question: Why was the JWT access token expiration changed to 15 minutes?
questions.ground_truth_fact: Changed from 2 hours to 15 minutes to limit replay attack windows.

questions.question: What happened with the multi-currency migration under ticket SL-287?
questions.ground_truth_fact: Deployed to staging but rolled back same day due to floating-point rounding mismatches in Stripe ledger.

questions.question: What retry policy is configured for Stripe webhooks?
questions.ground_truth_fact: Exponential backoff with max 5 retries over 24 hours.

questions.question: Where are token blacklists stored for logout revocation?
questions.ground_truth_fact: Stored in Redis for explicit logout token blacklisting.

questions.question: What is our zero-downtime database migration policy?
questions.ground_truth_fact: Two-phase additions with nullable columns before deploying code that reads them.

questions.question: Why did the multi-currency deployment get reverted on the same day?
